issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares addGuestStudents(int) as returning void, but the solution implements addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. This mismatch in method return type is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about the expected signature and return behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution's method to match the UML by declaring addGuestStudents(int) as void and simply update the numberOfGuestStudents field, or update the problem statement/UML and template to specify a boolean return (and explain the meaning of the boolean). Preferably align the solution and template with the UML (void) so students implement the signature as specified in the exercise.
